Ask about this service

How it works

We begin with a site visit and a conversation about the people who will use the garden. After agreeing the brief, we develop a concept and review it with you. The final plan gives you a clear basis for discussing the work with a landscaper.

Before you book

Construction, specialist surveys and planting supply are quoted separately. Complex sites may need additional technical drawings.
